question_text: Construct method pay(self, hours) in class Rental, returning self.ADMIN_FEE for stays of at most 5 hours and 0 otherwise. Assume hours is a nonnegative integer.
adaptation_rationale: Construct Python method retaining boundary condition. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution:
def pay(self,hours):
    return self.ADMIN_FEE if hours <= 5 else 0
